A '''trader''' working in the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] industry resided on the planetoid [[Zygerria Four]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. When Zygerria Four [[Bombardment of Zygerria Four|underwent orbital bombardment]], the slaver left the planetoid, abandoning a [[Zygerria Four palace|palace]].<ref name="In the Wake">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Scavenging|In the Wake}}</ref>
